episodes.title: Actus Reus
episodes.summary: Brilliant forensic pathologist Doctor Daniel Harrow investigates the apparent suicide of a young woman whose grieving father suspects she was murdered.

episodes.title: Ex Animo
episodes.summary: While stalling the river bones investigation, Harrow digs into the case of a woman murdered with a crossbow, coming dangerously close to a thrill-kill murderer.

episodes.title: Hic Sunt Dracones
episodes.summary: A human arm in a dead crocodile leads Harrow and Dass to Far North Queensland, battling crocs and crooks in their pursuit of the truth.

episodes.title: Finis Vitae Sed Non Amoris
episodes.summary: When a skeleton is discovered in a suburban backyard, the home owner becomes the prime murder suspect - until Harrow begins to uncover a tragic secret.

episodes.title: Non Sum Qualis Eram
episodes.summary: Harrow comes to Fern's aid after she unwittingly sells deadly party drugs, leaving a young woman dead and others hospitalised.

episodes.title: Aurum Potestas Est
episodes.summary: Two young travellers are dead and Harrow suspects the involvement of a prominent international businessman - but vested bureaucratic forces confound him at every turn.

episodes.title: Pia Mater
episodes.summary: While Harrow investigates the deaths of a mother and son in a car accident, the mystery of Robert Quinn's disappearance escalates into a homicide investigation.

episodes.title: Peccata Patrisi
episodes.summary: While Harrow investigates the accidental death of a young, gay student, Stephanie comes under increasing suspicion regarding the disappearance of Robert Quinn.

episodes.title: Lex Talionis
episodes.summary: A suspicious death at a nursing home causes Harrow to reflect on his own crime, as the investigation into Robert Quinn's murder gains momentum.

episodes.title: Mens Rea
episodes.summary: In the Season finale, Harrow deals with his most bizarre autopsy yet, both Dass and Simon finally close in on the truth about who killed Robert Quinn.

episodes.title: Abo Imo Pectore
episodes.summary: Harrow recovers from a near-fatal shooting and returns immediately to work, investigating the tragic puzzle of a young mother's psychotic episode while trying to figure out who shot him.

episodes.title: Audere Est Facere
episodes.summary: Harrow investigates the death of two base jumpers while Fern deals with the fallout of her arrest on serious drug allegations.

episodes.title: Malum In Se
episodes.summary: When a mummified body is found bricked up in the basement of a suburban home, Harrow and Grace set about uncovering a grim secret that has been buried for 20 years.

episodes.title: Aegri Somnia
episodes.summary: Harrow resolves to believe that Chester really is dead, and takes a case in North Queensland, while Simon launches his own investigation into Chester

episodes.title: Ab Initio
episodes.summary: Coping with a death that strikes close to home by focusing on work, Harrow is stunned to discover a connection between this death and another deceased man on his autopsy table.

episodes.title: Locus Poenitentiae
episodes.summary: Harrow and Fairley are sent to a double-fatality in Fairley's hometown - a trip that will test their already-strained relationship.

episodes.title: Parce Sepulto
episodes.summary: As Harrow and Grace investigate the death of a popular health and wellness vlogger, Harrow agitates for the exhumation of Chester's remains.

episodes.title: Sub Silentio
episodes.summary: While Grace autopsies the body of an elderly man discovered in an Egyptian sarcophagus, Harrow finds himself in a battle for his own life.

episodes.title: Facilis Descensus
episodes.summary: Harrow is desperate to prove once and for all that Francis Chester is alive and trying to kill him, but with no proof, even his most-trusted friends and colleagues doubt Harrow's state of mind.

episodes.title: Pater Familias
episodes.summary: In a thrilling climax, Harrow comes face-to-face with his greatest fears as Chester initiates the endgame.

episodes.title: Marta Semper Cerva Est
episodes.summary: When a young man who claimed to be Harrow's son turns up dead, Harrow is driven to understand the mystery and finds himself entangled in an underworld of cybercrime, crypto-piracy, and murder.

episodes.title: Damnant Quod Non Intellegunt
episodes.summary: Reeling from the discovery that his son is alive, Harrow finds a welcome distraction in one of the most bizarre cases he's ever encountered: the murder of a vampire.

episodes.title: Tarde Venientibus Ossa
episodes.summary: Harrow proves a suburban suicide is in fact murder, uncovering one family's secrets as he is forced to hide his own.

episodes.title: Per Stirpes
episodes.summary: Harrow is reminded why he hates camping on a hiking trip with Fairley and Nichols, but things turn strange when the trio find themselves conducting an impromptu murder investigation and a life-or-death battle.

episodes.title: Ut Biberent Quoniam Esse Nollent
episodes.summary: As Harrow's attempts to reconnect with his son are frustrated, Fern and James grow closer - while the baffling deaths of two teens sharpen Harrow's concern for his own children.

episodes.title: Ne Puero Gladium
episodes.summary: While pressure mounts on Harrow to stop defending his son James, two baffling deaths demand all his wit and courage to solve - before another life is lost.

episodes.title: Sola Dosis Facit Venenum
episodes.summary: The mysterious death of a hotel maid draws Harrow into a dark world of espionage and assassination, while Nichols edges closer to catching Harrow's wayward son James.

episodes.title: Alea Iacta Est
episodes.summary: After two men die in a duel, Harrow uncovers a web of Machiavellian intrigue within a suburban historical society. Meanwhile, the return of Tanya forces Harrow to reassess the last twenty years of his life.

episodes.title: Quam Innocentum Damnari
episodes.summary: While Harrow investigates a baffling crime involving siblings, James brings danger closer to his half-sister Fern than ever before - and pays a high price.

episodes.title: Ab Initio
episodes.summary: Harrow rides the storm when a deathly ill boy at QIFM needs his help at the very moment Mila Zoric summons him to negotiate his kidnapped son's release. But there's one lightning bolt shock he did not see coming.
